items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Base said, 'I'm not going.' ... He says, 'That's our tour, you know.'

ctx.x: to go, you know, we'd never been there. So all of a sudden -- we'd gotten all ready shot-wise and everything, Basie said, "I'm not going." So we says, "What are you talking about?" We thought he was kidding at first. So he said, "No, I'm serious. I'm really not going." So we said, "Well, man, we ain't never been to Europe. Why don't you want to go to Europe?" He says, "Well, --" Somebody -- he had a feeling, fortune-teller or something told him not to go. She said, "I see danger in this trip." And he was a little…

So we -- Miss Foster, she was like the producer of the Rockettes. So one morning, we had rehearsal about 7:30. So he had the paper in his arm. So he says -- he walked down in front of the reed section and he says, "You guys, you ain't going to say, 'Base, you was right one time,'? You're not going to compliment me or anything?" So everybody says, "What the hell is he talking about?" He said, "Well, don't you guys read the damn papers?"
